sprichwoerter.text: Chi dorme non piglia pesci.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you do not act, you get nothing.

sprichwoerter.text: Meglio tardi che mai.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to do something late than not at all.

sprichwoerter.text: Non tutto il male viene per nuocere.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Something good can come out of a bad thing.

sprichwoerter.text: Meglio un uovo oggi che una gallina domani.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you have now is worth more than what you only might get later.

sprichwoerter.text: A caval donato non si guarda in bocca.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Do not criticise a gift.

sprichwoerter.text: Can che abbaia non morde.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who threaten a lot rarely do anything.

sprichwoerter.text: Dimmi con chi vai e ti dirò chi sei.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Your friends say a lot about you.

sprichwoerter.text: Occhio non vede, cuore non duole.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you do not know cannot hurt you.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi troppo vuole nulla stringe.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you want too much, you end up with nothing.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi va piano va sano e va lontano.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Go slowly and carefully, and you will get far.

sprichwoerter.text: L'abito non fa il monaco.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You cannot judge a person by their clothes.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi trova un amico trova un tesoro.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A friend is worth a treasure.

sprichwoerter.text: Paese che vai, usanza che trovi.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Every place has its own customs.

sprichwoerter.text: Tale padre, tale figlio.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A child is often like the parent.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi la fa l'aspetti.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you do something bad to someone, expect the same back.

sprichwoerter.text: Il lupo perde il pelo ma non il vizio.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People do not change their bad habits.

sprichwoerter.text: Tra il dire e il fare c'è di mezzo il mare.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Saying is easy, doing is hard.

sprichwoerter.text: Rosso di sera, bel tempo si spera.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A red sky in the evening means good weather tomorrow.

sprichwoerter.text: Ride bene chi ride ultimo.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The one who wins in the end is the one who is right.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi fa da sé fa per tre.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you do it yourself, you get more done.

sprichwoerter.text: L'unione fa la forza.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People are stronger together.

sprichwoerter.text: Il mattino ha l'oro in bocca.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The morning is the best time to work.

sprichwoerter.text: Ogni medaglia ha il suo rovescio.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Everything good has a bad side too.

sprichwoerter.text: Una rondine non fa primavera.
sprichwoerter.sub: = One good sign does not prove that things have changed.

sprichwoerter.text: Il gioco non vale la candela.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is not worth the effort.

sprichwoerter.text: Quando il gatto non c'è, i topi ballano.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People behave badly when nobody is watching.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi si loda s'imbroda.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who praise themselves look silly.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi cerca trova.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you look hard enough, you will find it.

sprichwoerter.text: Non è tutto oro quel che luccica.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Things that look good are not always good.

sprichwoerter.text: Il tempo è denaro.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Time is valuable, so do not waste it.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi semina vento raccoglie tempesta.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you cause trouble, you will get worse trouble back.

sprichwoerter.text: Natale con i tuoi, Pasqua con chi vuoi.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Spend Christmas with your family, Easter with whoever you like.

sprichwoerter.text: A buon intenditor poche parole.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A clever person needs only a few words.

sprichwoerter.text: Chi ben comincia è a metà dell'opera.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A good start is half the work.

sprichwoerter.text: Meglio soli che male accompagnati.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to be alone than with bad company.

sprichwoerter.text: Roma non fu fatta in un giorno.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Big things take time.

redewendungen.sub: = Good luck! (The answer is "Crepi!")
= To look forward to something very much.
= To be involved in something and have influence on it.

redewendungen.text: Prendere due piccioni con una fava
redewendungen.sub: = To solve two problems with one action.
= To have no money.
= To be very expensive.
= To rain very hard.
= To be angry with someone for a long time.
= To be far from finishing something.

redewendungen.text: Mettere il carro davanti ai buoi
redewendungen.sub: = To do things in the wrong order.
= To break the first silence and start a conversation.
= To make fun of someone.
= To be extremely happy.
= To think about the same thing all the time.
= To do everything possible to manage something.
= To talk around a subject without coming to the point.
= To run away or leave quietly.

redewendungen.text: Avere la testa tra le nuvole
redewendungen.sub: = To be distracted and not pay attention.
= To say exactly what you think.
= To pretend not to hear.
= To be good, clever and reliable.
= Do not tell anyone, keep it secret.
= To embarrass yourself in public.
= To be very surprised, as if you knew nothing.
= To help someone.
= To be nearly finished.
= To drink too much alcohol.

redewendungen.text: Mettere i bastoni tra le ruote
redewendungen.sub: = To make it hard for someone to succeed.
= To be good with plants.
= To try something and get no result.
= To be excellent at something.
= To go very well.

redewendungen.text: Cercare un ago in un pagliaio
redewendungen.sub: = To look for something almost impossible to find.
= To be in the same situation as others.
= To touch iron so that bad luck stays away.

redewendungen.text: Prendere il toro per le corna
redewendungen.sub: = To face a difficult problem directly.
= To be everywhere, in every place or story.

redewendungen.text: Fare di tutta l'erba un fascio
redewendungen.sub: = To treat very different things or people as if they were all the same.
= To feel guilty and to expect to be blamed.

redewendungen.text: Parli del diavolo e spuntano le corna
redewendungen.sub: = Said when the person you were just talking about appears.
